name: Klemi
shortDescription: A UK church-administration platform for small and medium churches, combining people records, service planning, rotas, communications, giving, events and a member mobile app.
suitableContexts: Small and medium churches wanting one system for people records, roles and services
Churches that use Google services and want administration linked to their organisational account
Teams seeking a published GBP monthly price and optional implementation support

pricing.summary: Klemi's current client terms publish a Standard Licence at £30 plus VAT per month, an optional Settling In service at £30 plus VAT per month, and mobile-app access at £10 plus VAT per month. Confirm which components are needed and the total inclusive VAT cost in writing.

tiers.label: Standard Licence
tiers.detail: Members, groups, prayer diary, attendance, service planning, projection, rotas, newsletter integration, sermon library, payments and events

tiers.label: Settling In
tiers.detail: Initial training, setup guidance, phone support, coaching and consultancy

tiers.label: Mobile App
tiers.detail: Access to the tool through the mobile app

dataHosting: Klemi's terms say the tool uses each church's instance of Google services and other third-party content services, and requires access to Google Drive. Ask for the complete hosting architecture, storage locations, sub-processors, backups and resilience arrangements for the church's configuration.
gdprInformation: The current client terms include a data-protection schedule that describes Klemi as processor for uploaded and recorded personal data, with the church as controller, and refers to GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Obtain the current privacy notice, the completed processing schedule, security information, sub-processor list, breach process and retention arrangements before importing pastoral or safeguarding-sensitive records.
integrations: Google Drive is required by the supplier's terms
Supplier documentation describes Google services interaction, including calendar use
importExport: The terms say Klemi will, on request at termination, provide a digital copy of content uploaded to the tool or delete its copy; confirm formats, scope, timing and any cost before purchase
support: Email support with the Standard Licence
Optional initial training, setup guidance, phone support, coaching and consultancy

uk-purchasing.value: Klemi.co LLP is active on the UK register under number OC414047, with a South Croydon registered office.

gbp-pricing.value: Klemi's current client terms publish a £30 plus VAT monthly Standard Licence, £30 plus VAT Settling In service and £10 plus VAT mobile-app access.

data-protection-roles.value: The client terms describe the church as controller and Klemi as processor for uploaded and recorded Protected Data.

hosting-and-sub-processors.value: The published terms reference Google and other third-party content services; ask for the full hosting architecture, locations, sub-processors and backup arrangements.

migration.value: The terms describe a termination export of uploaded content; ask for routine import scope, export formats, timing and migration support.

editorial.assessment: Klemi is a broad but clearly church-focused system for a smaller team that wants people records, service planning and communication in one place. The published terms make its base price, optional mobile app and data-processing roles more concrete than many small suppliers. Its Google-service dependency and wide operational scope mean a church should trial real permissions, record ownership, rota workflows and exit data before committing.
bestFor: Small and medium churches seeking a unified administration and worship-planning tool
Churches already comfortable operating through Google services
Teams that want supplier-supported setup rather than configuring a platform alone
strengths: UK LLP identity and current client terms are publicly available
Published monthly GBP fees, including the optional app and implementation service
Feature scope joins membership, attendance, planning, rotas, communications, events, donations and sermon materials
Terms set out controller and processor roles for core uploaded records
limitations: Confirm full Google and third-party service architecture, storage locations, sub-processors and backups
Test Gift Aid workflow, payment reconciliation and reporting with the church's finance process
Confirm migration formats, access controls, support response, training scope and exit timetable
It is aimed at small to medium churches; larger or multi-site needs should be tested against real governance requirements

procurementVerdict.problem: Keeping people records, service rotas, attendance and congregational communication aligned in a small church office

procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask for the current data-processing and hosting details, then run a real-data pilot covering member permissions, service planning, Gift Aid reporting and a sample export
